productItems.productItemName: EB tresos 9 - AutoCore Generic Security Package
productItems.aiSelectionInstruction:

1) EB modules (SWCs) for BMW EES25 specific extensions.

productItems.aiSelectionInstruction:

- "EB tresos 7" is required
- ECUs integrate a cryptographic hardware extensions like Secure Hardware Extension (SHE)
- Compilance with Evita SHE is required

Notes: incompatible with "EB tresos 8" and "EB tresos 9" products

Description: Hardware-dependent MCAL driver for ACG7 CSM (EB tresos 7) to access crypto hardware. Concept license only available for selected hardware derivates.

EB zentur CrySHE provides access to cryptographic hardware extensions, e.g. Secure Hardware Extension
(SHE). As depicted in Figure 3.1, “EB tresos AutoCore Generic 7 Crypto and Security Stack modules”, EB
zentur CrySHE acts as a lower interface to ACG7 CSM, which in turn provides access to the cryptographic
functionalities to the user via services.

The access to the hardware-based cryptographic functions is provided as asynchronous functions. To be able
to use the hardware-based cryptographic functionality provided by EB zentur CrySHE within an AUTOSAR
environment, ACG7 CSM is needed. In ACG7 CSM, configurations need to be created which link to the algorithms
provided within EB zentur CrySHE. EB zentur CrySHE is hardware-dependent and shall be ordered
individually for the target hardware and compiler version.

Notes: this package is not compatible with third party HSM firmare like NXP's HSE
